scope: Independent Apple hosted-target/import closure, actual protected-journal lifecycle, queue-owned bounded HTTP fixture, teardown and evidence review. No code edit, compiler, Swift/XCTest, runtime HTTP, Native/Mac/Oracle action or control replay.

closedFindings.correction: Only removal predicate and explanatory comment changed. Both no thrown error and an existing run with totalFailureCount==0 are required; a nil testRun retains the fixture. No early hasSucceeded assumption.

applePrimary.meaning: Aggregate of test failures and uncaught exceptions recorded during the run.

reviewedBoundaries: Existing AnytypeTests directly links required products; testable Native reaches the original internal owner initializer/close, and testable Host reaches existing DEBUG openForTesting. No new product hook, mock journal, target bridge or API is introduced.

Actual protected loader/reserve/append/poison/flock code remains unchanged. The owned directory is changed0700→0500 only after reading the original caller intent and reservation, before controlledHTTP201; non-root operation is required.

The mode fault retains device/inode identity before later checks; restoration validates the same owned directory and0700 readback. No empty replacement namespace or invented receipt token is substituted.

Original presentation lifetime cancels and awaits its registered tasks. Actual owner.close awaits session.revokeAndDrain before journal.close releases flock; descriptor deallocation is not claimed at close.
After original sockets close, the same protected namespace reopens with reserved identity; a different real session generation, same recovery actor and pending JSON are required.

Original Check uses the unchanged pending intent with no new mutationID/URL or POST. Exact original file, one upload, two metadata reads, one range/digest read, FilesV2 readback and protected pending removal are asserted.

The bounded transport reuses the complete original listener class through a16-edit exact inverse. Mutable state stays on one serial queue; the connection state handler avoids capturing its own connection strongly.

All accepted sockets, including rejected over-budget or late sockets, are tracked until cancellation callbacks.512 is cumulative connection/request allowance;16 is the simultaneous admission threshold, with rejected sockets retained until terminal callbacks.

Cleanup preserves the first thrown failure and also records later errors. Positive listener cancellation and zero tracked sockets are required before removing only the fresh root whose owner/device/inode/mode still match. Assertion-only failures now retain that root too.
The original caller storage namespace is never recursively removed. Fresh synthetic account/Space identities isolate this controlled fixture from retained user/Native accounts.

Actual foreground scene, mounted editor, real SwiftUI attachment pane and actual rendered screenshots are used. Draw success is checked after JSON/PNG retention. Picker callback and model Check are invoked directly, not described as system-picker/XCUITest taps.
futureRequiredEvidence: Exact matching full-caller bba403/949651 plus W1 063d must be in the admitted future App source; current source pins are preparation only.

Actual Debug testability and true conditional imports are required. Repository AnyTypeTests versus PBX AnytypeTests casing must be resolved by the existing build materialization and proven in actual SwiftFileList/compiler inputs.
Exact one-method enumeration and original XCTest result are required. A missing conditional or source cannot be credited as a skip/pass.
All hosted UIKit/HTTP/journal execution, actual fault/reopen/cleanup, screenshot visual review and physical protection acceptance remain NOT_RUN or PENDING.
acceptanceLimits: ControlledHTTP + actual UIKit/shared model/Host/Engine client + real protected journal is distinct from real Native engine behavior.
Internal owner assembly does not prove production account sign-in/connect/reconnect, native ID durability, peer sync or process-death recovery.
Single seven-byte fixture is not the earlier Native tier acceptance or a replay of accepted uploader/store/renderer cases.
